interactive_engine_science.operation_scope: HTML agent independently exercised shipped JS control paths and inspected 19 SVG states; this report certifies scientific relationships and declared model scope, not a clinical or empirical model.

assessment_scope: Teacher-authored checkpoints of selected taught outcomes, not official examinations, grade predictions or accreditation completion.
review_controls: Source reviews are read-only unless an exact coordinated correction is agreed. Never recursively replace text across JSON values; scientific data, colours, URLs, schema, geometry and metadata are protected.

coordinated_prose_edits.method: Known literal replacements, restricted to semantic prose keys; no regular-expression substitution. SOW metadata retained exactly. Numeric token sequences asserted unchanged for every edited existing string. Added one explicit health warm-up paper block.
